product.title: Fort Lauderdale’s Tropical Kayak Tour and Island Adventure
product.description: It can be tricky to know the best places to go kayaking in Fort Lauderdale without local knowledge, so save the research time and go on this private tour instead. Set off with your guide on a trip through Wilton Manors—a scenic and secluded area that locals love. Discover places off the usual tourist trail such as hidden mangroves, and enjoy the perk of having a private guide to chat to along the way.
highlights: Avoid crowded tourist hotspots and go kayaking in a place that locals love
Chance to see quieter parts of Fort Lauderdale such as Wilton Manors
Private guide means plenty of opportunities to ask questions
Learn where to find hidden mangroves and secret nature spots
